claim_assessments.reason: The evidence describes SNI-GNN as mitigating embedding staleness in decentralized full-graph GNN training by predicting current remote-embedding values within the network.
The evidence states that each node has a GPU and a SmartNIC, identified as a DPU, with the GPU handling model computation and the DPU handling in-network processing.
The evidence states that the DPU maintains historical embedding caches and performs lightweight prediction.
The evidence states that Sync Epochs exchange fresh embeddings and update DPU caches, while Stale Epochs have DPUs supply predicted embeddings to local GPUs.
